grammar_notes.text: The marker 'he' can indicate animacy or sentience in Woccon. It appears in words like brother, dog, and Indian.
grammar_notes.source_excerpt: he could be a marker for animacy/sentient It occurs in brother, dog, and indian

grammar_notes.text: Proto-Siouan and Proto-Catawban are distinct reconstructions. Proto-Siouan is considered to be below the level of Proto-Siouan Catawba.
grammar_notes.source_excerpt: Relationship between shared ancestor between proto-siouan and catawba, there is also proto-siouan and proto-catawba. Lots of comparison in proto-siouan.

pronunciation_notes.text: The glottal stop is represented by '?'
Nasality tends to disappear over time in Woccon.
pronunciation_notes.source_excerpt: Au work= one of the first sounds to go away over time is nasality.

cultural_notes.text: The community is working on revitalizing Woccon language and culture through meetings and homework.
Grant funds are being used for the long house project, including figuring out roofing.
cultural_notes.source_excerpt: Grant funds from our long house project… we are trying to figure out roofing.
